declarations.name: dateTimeFormatOptions
declarations.description:
The `Intl.DateTimeFormat` options for `options`. `Intl` refuses a style next to an individual field, so `dateStyle`
and `timeStyle` win and the fields are ignored; with neither and no field the date is shown in the `medium` style.

declarations.name: formatDate
declarations.description: Formats `date` with `Intl.DateTimeFormat` in `options.locale` (else the browser's language).

A date and time formatted for the reader's language and, optionally, a fixed time zone, with
`Intl.DateTimeFormat`. Either pick a preset length with `date-style` and `time-style`, or name the fields to show
(`weekday`, `year`, `month`, `day`, `hour`, `minute`, `second`, `time-zone-name`, `era`); the presets win when both
are given, because `Intl` cannot mix them. With neither, the date shows in the `medium` style ("Oct 14, 2026").

The language is `locale`, else the nearest `lang` attribute (followed as soon as it changes), else the browser's.
`time-zone` takes an IANA name such as `UTC` or `Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh`; without it the reader's own zone is used, so
set it whenever the page is rendered on a server and the text must not change on hydration.

`date` takes an ISO 8601 string or a timestamp in milliseconds in markup, and a `Date` as a property. The text sits in
a `<time>` element whose `datetime` is the exact instant. Until `date` holds a valid date the element shows its
default slot, for a fallback such as "No date". An invalid `locale` or `time-zone` falls back to the defaults rather
than rendering nothing.
declarations.name: FormatDate

cssProperties.description: Colour of the text; inherits the surrounding text colour.
cssProperties.name: --c2-format-date--color

cssProperties.description: Digit style; tabular digits line dates up in a column.
cssProperties.name: --c2-format-date--font-variant-numeric

cssProperties.description: Whether the text may wrap between its words.
cssProperties.name: --c2-format-date--white-space

cssParts.description: The `<time>` element holding the formatted date, with the machine-readable `datetime`.
cssParts.name: time

slots.description: Fallback content shown while `date` is unset or not a valid date.

members.name: date
members.description: The moment to show: an ISO 8601 string or a millisecond timestamp in markup, or a `Date` from script.

members.name: dateStyle
members.description: Preset length of the date: `full` ("Wednesday, October 14, 2026"), `long`, `medium` or `short` ("10/14/26").

members.name: timeStyle
members.description: Preset length of the time: `full`, `long`, `medium` ("3:05:09 PM") or `short` ("3:05 PM"). Empty shows no time unless a time field is set.

members.name: weekday
members.description: Day of the week: `long` ("Wednesday"), `short` ("Wed") or `narrow` ("W"). Ignored when a style is set.

members.name: era
members.description: Era: `long` ("Anno Domini"), `short` ("AD") or `narrow` ("A"). Ignored when a style is set.

members.name: year
members.description: Year: `numeric` ("2026") or `2-digit` ("26"). Ignored when a style is set.

members.name: month
members.description: Month: `numeric`, `2-digit`, `long` ("October"), `short` ("Oct") or `narrow` ("O"). Ignored when a style is set.

members.name: day
members.description: Day of the month: `numeric` or `2-digit`. Ignored when a style is set.

members.name: hour
members.description: Hour: `numeric` or `2-digit`. Ignored when a style is set.

members.name: minute
members.description: Minute: `numeric` or `2-digit`. Ignored when a style is set.

members.name: second
members.description: Second: `numeric` or `2-digit`. Ignored when a style is set.

members.name: timeZoneName
members.description: Time zone name: `short` ("PST"), `long`, `shortOffset` ("GMT-8"), `longOffset`, `shortGeneric` or `longGeneric`. Ignored when a style is set.

members.name: timeZone
members.description: IANA time zone the date is shown in, such as `UTC` or `Europe/Paris`. Empty uses the reader's time zone.

members.name: hourFormat
members.description: Clock: `auto` follows the locale, `12` shows AM/PM, `24` a 24-hour clock.

members.name: locale
members.description: BCP 47 locale of the text. Empty uses the nearest `lang` attribute, then the browser's language.

members.name: #language
members.description: `locale`, else the nearest `lang`, else the browser's language; a `lang` change redraws the text at once.
